sources.title: Kander README
sources.locator: Key Features; Quick Start; Key Commands; GitHub Integration; FAQ
sources.finding: Rule-driven multi-agent kanban with two-stage independent review gates, conflict-aware scheduling, git worktree plus tmux/herdr isolation and zero-token GitHub integration via gh; Homebrew, Linux tarball and Windows zip; needs Git and one of Codex, Claude, Grok, Cursor or Pi; MIT.

sources.title: Installation and permission boundaries
sources.locator: Automatic updates; Installation; Rules injection switch; uninstall
sources.finding: Binary installs itself (kander install), TUI start checks the latest GitHub release with a five-second deadline and offers an update, rules are written to ~/.agents/kander or a project .kander/rules, install_rules switch gates writes to agent files.

sources.title: Terminal backends
sources.finding: Backends dsh, herdr, herdr-core, luvus, tmux, tmux-session and foreground/console; POSIX-only except foreground/console and herdr; backend features degrade by capability.

sources.title: Durable dispatch protocol
sources.finding: At-most-once instruction delivery with dispatch_id, acceptance tracking and completion receipts; status is never inferred from screen echo.

sources.title: Card transactions and recovery
sources.finding: File-level card transactions with ordered locks and crash recovery; task_id anchors identity, controlled CLI commands write cards.

sources.title: Orchestration checkpoints and recovery
sources.finding: kander coordinator claim/reconcile/recover stores versioned group checkpoints under kanban/.kander/groups for recovery; it does not run the loop, notify, move cards or delete worktrees.

sources.title: Review disposition and completion gate
sources.locator: Workflow pipeline (L1-L40); execution cycles and plans
sources.finding: Every active card needs a sealed review plan with roles (PMQA, Security) before done; independent reviewer runs, findings assigned to cards, author disposition with commit SHAs and test evidence, batch close unblocks move done.

sources.title: Review runtime isolation
sources.finding: Reviewers are the nine built-in agents or configured agents with a review template; isolation arguments per agent; kander review is the single gate entry.

sources.title: Custom execution agents
sources.finding: Nine built-in agents (codex, claude, grok, cursor, pi, devin, opencode, kimi, droid) defined by embedded JSON; user-defined agents via config.json argv templates; project .kander-config.json overlay.

sources.title: Multi-model routing
sources.finding: Different execution agents for small and large cards and different reviewers per role; guidance, not defaults.

sources.title: GitHub issue import
sources.finding: kander issue import NUMBER creates an idempotent backlog card from a GitHub issue in one exclusive board transaction, storing raw remote text as attachments; uses gh credentials.

sources.title: GitHub issue result reconciliation
sources.finding: kander issue result adds result comments to the bound issue; closing requires separate explicit confirmation.

sources.title: Check command
sources.finding: kander check validates the board and liveness; check delivery and check overlap are read-only Git analyzers.

sources.title: Kanban write guard
sources.finding: kander guard-write blocks creating cards outside the controlled entry point, for host pre-write hooks.

sources.title: Subscription committed facts
sources.finding: kander subscribe outputs versioned JSON Lines of member state changes for a coordinator agent.

sources.title: Production stats
sources.finding: Maintainer-reported counts as of 2026-10-29: 2,477 task cards, 2,865 review runs across five projects; vendor figures, not catalog measurements.

sources.title: Windows Microsoft Store (MSIX)
sources.finding: MSIX bundle for x64 and arm64 with an execution alias; a successful build does not mean the package is published.

sources.title: Task group rules
sources.locator: Dependency graph; Running task cards in parallel (L31, L43-L48)
sources.finding: Groups list members and a dependency graph; parallel only for cards ready together whose modified files are isolated at file level; hotspot files go to exactly one card.

sources.title: Card content template
sources.finding: Cards are markdown specs with TYPE, SIZE, TASK_GROUP, OWNER, SESSION, WINDOW, TASK_BRANCH and RESULT fields.

sources.title: Kander changelog
sources.finding: Shipped changes per release up to v1.4.3.

sources.title: MIT License
sources.finding: MIT License covering the repository.

sources.title: Go module manifest
sources.finding: Go module github.com/dualface/kander; single-binary CLI.

sources.title: CLI command list
sources.finding: Command set includes list, show, new, move, pick, start, orchestrate and resume; tests assert the list.

sources.title: Claude agent definition
sources.finding: Claude is launched with --dangerously-skip-permissions or bypassPermissions.

sources.title: Codex agent definition
sources.finding: Codex is launched with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox.

sources.title: Cursor agent definition
sources.finding: Cursor is launched with --force or --yolo.

sources.title: Update check
sources.finding: Update check calls the GitHub releases API for dualface/kander and only trusts GitHub download hosts.

sources.title: GitHub repository API
sources.finding: Public repository dualface/kander: 325 stars, MIT license, pushed 2026-11-17 (observed 2026-11-17).

sources.title: Kander v1.4.3 release
sources.finding: Release v1.4.3 published 2026-11-17 with seven assets; v1.4.0 to v1.4.3 shipped within two days.

sources.title: Bounded search: other clients
sources.locator: ls cmd internal integrations; grep -rniE "http.ListenAndServe|websocket|electron|android|vscode" internal cmd
sources.finding: Only a terminal binary and a kander-dsh integration exist; no web server, desktop GUI, mobile app or editor extension (the author's separate QuickTUI product is a different closed app).

sources.title: Bounded search: cost
sources.finding: No agent cost or token accounting; matches are unrelated terminal and file-system code.

sources.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO
sources.finding: No users, roles, SSO or presence; a single local developer with several agents.

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
sources.finding: No cron, schedule or webhook; work starts when a user or coordinator agent runs kander commands.

sources.title: Bounded search: remote execution and sandbox
sources.finding: No remote host, container or VM execution; sandbox appears only inside agent argv flags.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry
sources.finding: No telemetry or analytics code; the only matches are the substring "sEntry" in install code.

sources.title: Bounded search: living specs and memory
sources.locator: grep -rniE "living spec|spec-driven|memory store|requirements doc" --include=*.go internal cmd rules
sources.finding: Cards carry their own spec.md; there is no cross-task living product specification or memory store.

sources.title: Orchestrator rule: handling blocked executing agents
sources.finding: At every heartbeat the orchestrator inspects working cards and judges a card blocked when its pane shows a dialog, question, repeated error or an agent CLI error (rate limit, context exhaustion, crashed tool), or liveness is stopped or drifted, and reports a card undeterminable for three heartbeats to the user; this is an agent-followed rule, not a built-in retry.

sources.title: Reviewer search: pull requests and CI
sources.locator: grep -rniE "pull request|\bPR\b|gh pr|merge request|statusCheckRollup|check_runs|gh run" internal cmd integrations rules docs README.md
sources.finding: Only issue-listing code filtering pull requests out, the Git rules sentence that explicit user or project requirements to use a PR still apply, and merge-back wording; no rule or code opens, reads or merges pull requests or reads CI checks. The Git rules default to local merge-back to the mainline.

sources.title: Reviewer search: CPU and RAM awareness
sources.locator: grep -rniE "runtime\.NumCPU|loadavg|NumCPU|GOMAXPROCS|memory limit|cpu limit|syscall\.Sysinfo" internal cmd integrations --include=*.go
sources.finding: No matches; scheduling is by file-overlap analysis, not host resources.

sources.title: Reviewer search: indexing and retrieval
sources.locator: grep -rniE "embedding|vector|semantic search|ripgrep|ctags|codebase index" internal cmd integrations --include=*.go
sources.finding: No matches; no repository index or retrieval feature.

sources.title: Reviewer search: dependencies, ports and secrets
sources.locator: grep -rniE "allocatePort|findFreePort|get-port|port range|docker-compose|npm install|node_modules|\.env\b" internal cmd integrations --include=*.go
sources.finding: Only command environment handling in terminal definitions, probes and Git checks; no dependency installation, cache, service, port or secret management for worktrees.

sources.title: Reviewer search: screenshots, recordings, galleries
sources.finding: Only an unrelated install comment; no screenshot, recording, preview or gallery feature.

sources.title: Reviewer search: audit log and export
sources.finding: No matches; no audit log, attribution or export command.

sources.title: Reviewer search: deployment, rollback, revert
sources.finding: Only board-transaction rollback of window metadata; no deployment link, release, revert or build link feature.
